name: frozen cucumber smoothie
instructions:
The dessert cucumber smoothie — cucumber + mango + greek yogurt + ice, blended. Served COLD, necessarily (see notes).

=== INGREDIENTS ===

- CUCUMBER
- MANGO — ideally FROZEN
- GREEK YOGURT
- ICE

=== PROCEDURE ===

UNDERBLEND — don't puree. Use the blender's manual 1-10 levels and do ACCELERATIONS FROM 2 TO 7, over and over, to WHIP it without pureeing. Serve immediately, cold.
notes:
=== DISTINCT FROM THE CUCUMBER-AVOCADO SMOOTHIE ===

This is NOT [[cucumber-avocado-smoothie]] (the pepper/avocado/cucumber one). Two differences draw the line:
1. This one NEEDS TO BE SERVED COLD — the frozen mango + ice are structural, not optional.
2. It doesn't have as much nutritional value — this is a DESSERT FRUIT SMOOTHIE, not the savory-leaning gazpacho-adjacent meal the avocado one is.

=== UNDERBLEND — WHIP, DON'T PUREE ===

The texture move: use the manual 1-10 speed levels and run accelerations from 2 to 7 over and over. This WHIPS the smoothie without pureeing it — deliberately underblended.

=== WANT TO TRY — CHILI POWDER / PUSH IT MEXICAN ===

CHILI POWDER or TAJIN (chili + lime + salt — the mexican street-fruit move on mango), or push it mexican somehow — direction open, not yet worked out.

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[cucumber-avocado-smoothie]]: the savory/nutritional cucumber smoothie (anaheim, avocado, coconut, lime, mint).
- [[spinach-yogurt-smoothie]]: the other greek-yogurt smoothie.
